title: Can You Fix the Mislabeled Pen Boxes?
summary: Three supply-room boxes, every label wrong. Which single pen do you take out to fix them all?

beats.text: Three pen boxes, every label wrong. Which box do you pick from: Red, Blue, or Mixed?
Boxes say Red, Blue and Mixed. One holds red pens, one blue, one both.
A coworker warns you: every single label is wrong. You may take out just one pen.
Time to decide. Which box do you take the pen from?
beats.reveal: The box labeled Mixed! Its label is wrong, so it holds only one color.

visual.question: Which box do you take a pen from?

beats.text: Say you pull a red pen. That box is all red. The Blue box can't be blue or red, so it's mixed.
